input.content:
Prepare the payroll batch total for Alder.
Source documents: alder-payroll-04.csv and alder-payroll-terms-04.csv.
Gross pay = regular_hours * hourly_rate + overtime_hours * hourly_rate * overtime_multiplier. Net pay = gross pay * (1 - withholding_rate) - deduction. Use the values in the terms table. Round monetary amounts to two decimal places using half-even rounding. Round each record amount first, then total those rounded amounts. Deliver JSON with records (the number of rows, as a number) and total_amount (a number).
Provide a delivery summary when finished.

{"command":"cat > /registry/shares/alder-payroll-04.csv <<'EOF'
record_id,regular_hours,overtime_hours,hourly_rate,deduction
EMP-001,159,7,31.19,202
EMP-002,145,6,27.4,165
EMP-003,158,7,42.76,168
EMP-004,130,9,23.1,138
EMP-005,144,4,23.06,173
EMP-006,148,9,40.39,174
EMP-007,154,10,32.54,138
EMP-008,150,2,36.51,231
EMP-009,156,8,45.9,191
EMP-010,143,6,32.84,207
EOF
python - <<'PY'
from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_EVEN
import csv, io
s='''record_id,regular_hours,overtime_hours,hourly_rate,deduction
EMP-001,159,7,31.19,202
EMP-002,145,6,27.4,165
EMP-003,158,7,42.76,168
EMP-004,130,9,23.1,138
EMP-005,144,4,23.06,173
EMP-006,148,9,40.39,174
EMP-007,154,10,32.54,138
EMP-008,150,2,36.51,231
EMP-009,156,8,45.9,191
EMP-010,143,6,32.84,207
'''
q=Decimal('0.01'); m=Decimal('1.73'); w=Decimal('0.2137')
tot=Decimal(0); tot2=Decimal(0)
for r in csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(s)):
    reg=Decimal(r['regular_hours']); ot=Decimal(r['overtime_hours']); rate=Decimal(r['hourly_rate']); ded=Decimal(r['deduction'])
    gross=reg*rate+ot*rate*m
    net=gross*(1-w)-ded
    rn=net.quantize(q, rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
    gross_r=gross.quantize(q,rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
    rn2=(gross_r*(1-w)-ded).quantize(q,rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
    print(r['record_id'],'gross',gross,'gross_r',gross_r,'net',net,'rounded',rn,'via rgross',rn2)
    tot+=rn; tot2+=rn2
print('TOTAL direct',tot,'TOTAL via rounded gross',tot2)
PY"}
